<ows:ExceptionText>Feature type with name 'bp_Flurstueck' is not served by this WFS.
=== confirm WFS layer list in capabilities (proves DB-backed layers resolved) ===

observation.command: grep -oE "<ows:ExceptionText>[^<]+" /tmp/gf3.xml | head -2; echo "=== confirm WFS layer list in capabilities (proves DB-backed layers resolved) ==="; timeout 40 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities&version=2.0.0" | grep -oE "<Name>[a-z0-9]+:[A-Za-z_0-9]+</Name>" | head -5
